description: READ EVERYTHING about an issue in one call: fields, full description, ALL comments, and the content of ALL files — attached to the issue, attached to comments, or linked in Markdown. Images come back as viewable images, text/JSON/CSV files inline, PDFs as text plus their first pages as images (scans and schemes too), Word/Excel/PowerPoint/OpenDocument/EPUB files as text plus embedded pictures, zip archives as a listing + local path, video/audio/other as a local file path. The most complete view of one issue.

include_media.description: default true: also return the content of every file (images viewable, text inline, zip listings, others saved locally)

raw_files.description: default false: ALSO attach every PDF/Office/other binary file untouched as an embedded document (up to 20 MB each), for clients that read such files natively

name: read_issue
